Name: PLAY_REGION_PARAM_ST
Description: Multiplayer and online rules for an area of a map. The row is the Play Region ID of the collision or map region the player is in. Controls whether multiplayer can start, invasion and sign limits, player position saving and warp item use.

Fields.Name: Multiplayer Zone ID
Fields.Description: ID of the multiplayer zone this region belongs to.

Fields.Name: Multiplayer Start Limit - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that limits starting multiplayer in this region. Flag ON: multiplayer allowed. Flag OFF: multiplayer forbidden. Not set: always allowed. The limiting state is set by Target Flag State - Multiplayer Start Limit ID [1].

Fields.Name: Invasion Point Min Distance
Fields.Description: Distance from the host within which other phantoms cannot invade. Invasion points are searched between this distance and the invasion range upper limit.

Fields.Name: Player Position Save Limit - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that limits saving the player's position in this region. Flag ON: position saved. Flag OFF: not saved. Not set: always saved.

Fields.Name: Multiplayer Host Limit - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: While this event flag is ON, multiplayer as a host is forbidden in this region. Normally an area clear flag. 0: no limit.

Fields.Name: White Phantom Entity ID - Free Frame
Fields.Description: First of the free-slot IDs used as entity IDs for NPCs summoned by the NPC white phantom summon ritual.

Fields.Name: Is Map Guardian Region
Fields.Description: When on, white-sign cooldowns in this region use the Guardian columns of WhiteSignCoolTimeParam instead of the Normal columns (applies only while multiplayer can start here).

Fields.Name: Is Yellow Monk Region
Fields.Description: Marks signs created in this region with the Yellow Monk flag.

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - Multiplayer Start Limit ID [1]
Fields.Description: Flag state (on/off) of Multiplayer Start Limit that blocks multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - Invasion Limit
Fields.Description: Flag state (ON/OFF) of the Invasion Limit event flag that applies the limit.

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - White Sign Limit
Fields.Description: Flag state (ON/OFF) of the White Sign Limit event flag that applies the limit.

Fields.Name: Target Flag State - Red Sign Limit
Fields.Description: Flag state (ON/OFF) of the Red Sign Limit event flag that applies the limit.

Fields.Name: Warp Item Usage Permitted - Bonfire ID [1]
Fields.Description: Bonfire entity ID1 used to determine whether to allow the use of warp items

Fields.Name: Warp Item Usage Permitted - Bonfire ID [2]
Fields.Description: Bonfire entity ID 2 used to determine permission to use warp items

Fields.Name: Warp Item Usage Permitted - Bonfire ID [3]
Fields.Description: Bonfire entity ID 3 used to determine permission to use warp items

Fields.Name: Warp Item Usage Permitted - Bonfire ID [4]
Fields.Description: Bonfire entity ID 4 used to determine permission to use warp items

Fields.Name: Warp Item Usage Permitted - Bonfire ID [5]
Fields.Description: Bonfire entity ID 5 used to determine permission to use warp items

Fields.Name: Warp Item Prohibition - Event Flag ID [1]
Fields.Description: Event flag: while any of the 5 flags is on, items marked as Warp Prohibited can't be used in this region. Takes priority over the Warp Item Usage Permitted - Bonfire ID check.

Fields.Name: Warp Item Prohibition - Event Flag ID [2]
Fields.Description: Event flag 2. See Warp Item Prohibition - Event Flag ID [1].

Fields.Name: Warp Item Prohibition - Event Flag ID [3]
Fields.Description: Event flag 3. See Warp Item Prohibition - Event Flag ID [1].

Fields.Name: Warp Item Prohibition - Event Flag ID [4]
Fields.Description: Event flag 4. See Warp Item Prohibition - Event Flag ID [1].

Fields.Name: Warp Item Prohibition - Event Flag ID [5]
Fields.Description: Event flag 5. See Warp Item Prohibition - Event Flag ID [1].

Fields.Name: Enable Bloodstain
Fields.Description: When off, other players' bloodstains are not downloaded in this region.

Fields.Name: Enable Blood Message
Fields.Description: When off, other players' messages are not downloaded in this region.

Fields.Name: Enable Ghost
Fields.Description: When off, other players' wandering phantoms are not downloaded in this region.

Fields.Name: Invasion Limit - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that limits invasions in this region. The limiting state is set by Target Flag State - Invasion Limit.

Fields.Name: Yellow Monk Host Limit - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: While this event flag is ON, multiplayer as a Yellow Monk host is forbidden in this region. Normally an area clear flag. 0: no limit.
